scope: minimum exact codelength within the fixed five-family categorical baseline set

checks.accounting: all five candidates pay one common three-bit family selector plus their length, model and data bits; previous code layouts and CSV modes remain byte-identical
checks.selection: verify independently constructed totals, a deterministic tie, and a fixture that selects each family
checks.round_trip: the selected frame decodes without a separate family ID; reject reserved tags, corrupt padding and truncated input
checks.incomplete_set: retain valid candidate lengths and mark an over-budget family, withhold selection when any family is unavailable, and continue to later snapshots
checks.install: test the CLI and installed API in the full conformance matrix

limits: in-sample categorical engineering comparison. No held-out fitting, structural gain or scientific calibration.
